name: human-atlas
description: Human Atlas — bilingual (RU/EN) training platform with an interactive 3D muscle map

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist && vite build --outDir dist/atlas && npm run build:academy
scripts.build:academy: npm --prefix rehab-academy ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix rehab-academy run build && cp -r rehab-academy/dist/. dist/
